papers.title: Policy-Conditioned Koopman Representations for Parameterized Closed-Loop Systems
papers.summary: Predicting the response of a nonlinear system across different feedback controllers requires a model that captures how the closed-loop dynamics change with the controller parameters. In a finite-dimensional Koopman model, these changes may affect both the latent dynamics and the observable coordinates used to represent them. In this paper, we propose a policy-conditioned Koopman representation framework to address this problem. This framework allows a single learned model to predict a family of closed-loop trajectories without retraining for each controller. We test the framework on four nonlinear prediction benchmarks, where the model stays below a 15% error threshold on every system, while each baseline exceeds it on at least one. As an example application, the resulting surrogate supports one-shot feedback-parameter selection: an optimization at the initial state selects a controller that then operates with fixed parameters and ongoing state feedback. On nonlinear control benchmarks including MuJoCo, the selected controllers stabilize every system with 3 to 97 times less online computation than nonlinear model predictive control. These results demonstrate how policy-dependent coordinates can support both prediction across closed-loop systems and controller selection without repeated online trajectory optimization.
papers.title_ja: パラメータ化された閉ループシステムのためのポリシー条件付きKoopman表現
papers.summary_ja: 非線形システムのフィードバック制御器パラメータに応じた閉ループ動態を、再学習なしで予測するポリシー条件付きKoopman表現フレームワークを提案する。単一の学習済みモデルで制御器ファミリーの軌道を予測し、4つの非線形予測ベンチマークで15%未満の誤差を達成した。さらに、このサロゲートモデルを用いたワンショットフィードバックパラメータ選択により、MuJoCoなどの非線形制御タスクにおいて、非線形モデル予測制御（NMPC）比で3〜97倍のオンライン計算量削減を実現しつつ安定化に成功した。

papers.title: Multifidelity Operator Inference for Dynamical Systems
papers.summary: This paper presents a multifidelity (MF) formulation of Operator Inference (OpInf) for learning non-intrusive, physics-based reduced-order models (ROMs) of nonlinear dynamical systems. OpInf learns reduced operators from projections of snapshot data by solving a least squares regression problem. However, generating high-fidelity snapshots can be computationally expensive, limiting parameter coverage and the temporal extent of training trajectories for many aerospace applications, which can lead to inaccurate or unstable ROM predictions. This work proposes MF-OpInf, which combines limited high-fidelity snapshots with more plentiful low-fidelity snapshots through a control-variates-inspired MF least squares formulation to learn a single set of reduced operators across multiple trajectories. Low-fidelity trajectories provide additional parameter coverage and extend beyond the high-fidelity training time horizon. The low-fidelity snapshots are also used to construct an improved reduced basis through weighted proper orthogonal decomposition. We demonstrate MF-OpInf on a nonlinear reaction-diffusion problem with parametrized sinusoidal forcing and a two-dimensional incompressible flow past a cylinder with a parametrized inlet pulse. In these experiments, under an equal training simulation budget, MF-OpInf reduces the mean relative prediction error at unseen parameters by up to $87\%$ for the reaction-diffusion problem and $28\%$ for the cylinder flow problem over the test time regime, which extends beyond the high-fidelity training time horizon. These results demonstrate that MF-OpInf can improve temporal extrapolation and prediction at unseen parameters without increasing the training simulation budget.
papers.title_ja: 動的システムのためのマルチフィデリティ演算子推論
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、非線形動的システムに対する非侵入型縮約モデル（ROM）の学習手法「マルチフィデリティ演算子推論（MF-OpInf）」を提案する。高忠実度シミュレーションのコストを削減するため、制御変数法に着想を得た最小二乗法により、限られた高忠実度データと豊富な低忠実度データを統合して演算子を学習する。反応拡散問題と円柱周りの流れのシミュレーションで検証し、訓練予算を維持したまま、未見パラメータにおける予測誤差を最大87%低減し、時間外挿性能を向上させることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 縮約モデルと物理情報学習の高度な組み合わせであり、ユーザーの関心と一致

papers.title: Generalized hydraulic neural operators turbocharging sewer digital twins
papers.summary: Hydraulic digital twins are emerging as the next-generation paradigm for operating and managing sewer systems. Conventional hydraulic digital twinning relies on running physics-based models (e.g., Saint-Venant equations), which are computationally expensive and often too slow for real-time applications. Although surrogates (e.g., neural networks) can be fast, existing approaches are typically non-generalizable, requiring costly retraining for unseen pipes, networks, or flow conditions. Here, we develop a fast, generalized and differentiable multi-branch neural operator trained on solutions of the Saint-Venant equations that predicts in-pipe hydraulics. The learned operator reproduces complex hydraulic dynamics with high fidelity while achieving thousand- to million-fold speedups for online prediction, data assimilation, and diagnostics. Equally importantly, the learned operator generalizes to unseen pipes, networks, and flow conditions without retraining. These advances address key computational barriers to real-time sewer digital twins, opening new opportunities for more responsive flood-risk management and protection of urban water environments.
papers.title_ja: 下水デジタルツインを高速化する汎用化された水力学ニューラルオペレータ
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、下水管路の水力学シミュレーションを高速化・汎用化する多分岐ニューラルオペレータを提案する。Saint-Venant方程式の解を学習データとして用い、未知のパイプやネットワーク、流況に対して再学習なしで高精度な予測を実現する。従来の物理ベースモデルと比較して、オンライン予測やデータ同化において1000倍から100万倍の高速化を達成した。この手法は、リアルタイム対応可能な下水デジタルツインの構築と、都市の洪水リスク管理への応用を可能にする。
papers.relevance_reason: ニューラルオペレータによる物理シミュレーション高速化と汎用性という関心領域に完全一致

papers.title: Fuse-PINN: Combining Finite Element Methods and Physics-Informed Neural Networks to enable massively parallel simulations of non-linear PDEs
papers.summary: Research in the domain of Physics-Informed Neural Networks applied to PDE modelling has advanced significantly in recent years, providing a wide ecosystem of novel methods. However, one frequent limitation is the inability of PINNs to scale out on High-Performance Computing architectures to address more ambitious challenges, particularly non-linear physics models with turbulent dynamics in large spatial domains. Typical studies restrain demonstrations to toy models with simple physics equations, few variables, and rarely any complex non-linear dynamics evolved over long timescales. Part of the AI community has even adopted the idea that "PINNs don't scale". This work proves otherwise. We present a mathematically robust formulation of Finite-Element-Method for Neural Networks (FEM-NN) implemented into a comprehensive, modular framework: Fuse-PINN. This formulation provides the basis for a sclable parallelisation of Physics-Informed Neural Networks on GPU-based HPC systems. Furthermore, an Energy Natural Gradient Descent optimiser is implemented to allow high-precision convergence. Fuse-PINN is demonstrated on physics models relevant to Magnetic Confinement Fusion, including non-linear convective models with fine-scale dynamics. Near-perfect scaling is achieved on multi-GPU runs with increasing problem size.
papers.title_ja: Fuse-PINN: 有限要素法と物理情報ニューラルネットワークを組み合わせ、非線形偏微分方程式の並列シミュレーションを可能にする
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、物理情報ニューラルネットワーク（PINN）が高性能計算（HPC）環境でスケーリングできないという課題に対し、有限要素法（FEM）とNNを統合したFuse-PINNフレームワークを提案する。GPUベースのHPCシステムでの並列化を可能にし、エネルギー自然勾配降下法による高精度収束を実現する。磁気閉じ込め核融合に関連する非線形対流モデルにおいて、問題サイズが増加してもほぼ完全なスケーリング性能を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: PINNとFEMの融合による大規模並列計算は、ユーザーの関心である物理情報NNとサロゲートモデルの高度な応用と一致する。

papers.title: A Surrogate Boundary Condition for Improved Accuracy and Performance of Local Modeling in Radiation Transport Simulations
papers.summary: Monte Carlo neutronics analysis of tokamak designs is computationally expensive due to the complex CAD geometries required to accurately model them. Design iteration of port plugs using global transport in the full model is impractical because of the computational cost. To circumvent this, local modeling methods are used. In the local modeling method, a boundary condition is assumed on the port plug, such that particles that leave the port plug do not require transport in the surrounding global model. For this purpose, vacuum and reflective boundaries are assumed, both of which provide poor approximation of the true transport physics in the global model. To improve on current techniques, a surrogate model is presented that provides a physics-informed boundary condition for the component. A neural network is trained to reproduce the boundary condition on the component that represents the behavior of particles returning from the surrounding geometry. Monte Carlo transport is only necessary within the component, and approximate physics from the surrounding region are retained. This approach allows the design in the component to be iterated without requiring full model transport and joining of the component mesh to the global mesh in each iteration. In this work, the surrogate model is evaluated against vacuum and reflective boundaries-- outperforming both in accuracy, with surrogate predictions of the flux in the port plug differing less than 12% from the global transport solution in any given energy bin. The surrogate boundary condition is also demonstrated to be more performant than global transport for the simplified benchmark geometry.
papers.title_ja: 放射線輸送シミュレーションにおける局所モデリングの精度と性能向上のためのサロゲート境界条件
papers.summary_ja: トカマク設計における計算コストの高いモンテカルロ中性子輸送解析を高速化するため、ポートプラグの局所モデリングに適用可能なサロゲート境界条件を提案する。周囲の幾何構造から戻る粒子の挙動を再現するニューラルネットワークを訓練し、物理情報に基づいた境界条件として機能させることで、全モデルでの輸送計算を不要にする。この手法は、従来の真空境界や反射境界よりも精度が高く、任意のエネルギービンのフラックス予測誤差を12%未満に抑えることを示した。さらに、簡易ベンチマークにおいて全輸送計算よりも計算性能が優れていることも実証されている。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルと物理情報を用いたシミュレーション高速化の具体例であり、関心領域と高度に一致する。

papers.title: Joint World Action Models through Differentiable Trajectory Optimization
papers.summary: Joint world action models (WAMs) generate future actions and states together, modeling world-action trajectories rather than actions alone. However, trajectory imitation does not ensure that these trajectories are task-effective or consistent with dynamics. We present \textbf{world action trajectory optimization (WATO)}, which optimizes generated actions and future states jointly for control. WATO uses both as references in a dynamics-constrained trajectory optimization problem and differentiates the task loss through the optimized trajectory to train the generator. This makes generated trajectories task-aware and dynamics-consistent while using trajectory optimization only during training. At deployment, WATO directly generates candidate trajectories and ranks them with a world model, without iterative trajectory optimization. Across $7$ visual control environments, WATO improves average success from $79.9\%$ for the imitation joint WAM to $91.7\%$, outperforming strong model-based, goal-conditioned RL, and generative control baselines. Compared with cross-entropy method (CEM), WATO is on average $11.5\times$ faster and uses $600.5\times$ fewer world model evaluations at deployment.
papers.title_ja: 微分可能軌道最適化によるジョイント・ワールド・アクション・モデル
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、将来のアクションと状態を同時に生成するジョイント・ワールド・アクション・モデル（WAM）の学習手法「WATO」を提案する。WATOは、訓練時にのみ動的制約付き軌道最適化を用い、最適化された軌道を通じてタスク損失を微分することで、生成器をタスク認識かつ力学系整合的に学習させる。デプロイ時には反復的な最適化を行わず、ワールドモデルによるランキングのみで候補軌道を選択するため、CEMと比較して平均11.5倍高速かつワールドモデル評価回数を大幅に削減できる。7つの視覚制御環境において、模倣学習ベースのWAMより成功率を向上させ、強化学習や生成制御のベースラインも上回る性能を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 軌道最適化と強化学習の融合、推論高速化、制御への応用が関心に合致

papers.title: Disturbance-Aware Informative Planning in Spatiotemporal Environments
papers.summary: Autonomous robots are widely used for persistent monitoring of spatiotemporal environments, where quantities of interest (QoI) change across space and time and require repeated measurements. In practice, robot motion can be affected by external disturbances that vary across the environment. When such external disturbances are not considered in trajectory optimization, it can lead to inaccurate predictions of robot motion and, consequently, the information acquired about the QoI during execution. However, estimating disturbances throughout the environment can be inefficient, as disturbances in regions with little overlap with monitoring trajectories have limited impact on monitoring performance. We therefore propose a two-stage informative planning framework for unknown, spatially varying but time-invariant disturbances, combining informed disturbance sampling with disturbance-aware trajectory optimization. First, we identify where QoI measurements are needed and generate alternative paths to these locations using the environment geometry. We then prioritize disturbance measurements based on their expected reduction of disturbance uncertainty along these paths. Second, rather than optimizing information acquisition based on nominal robot motion, we incorporate the learned disturbance belief into trajectory optimization to account for its effects on robot motion and information acquisition. Across four simulation scenarios, the proposed method reduces disturbance-learning time by 25.0--52.3 percent compared with environment-wide estimation and identifies paths that appear costly under nominal dynamics but become preferable when disturbances are considered.
papers.title_ja: 時空環境における擾乱認識型情報計画
papers.summary_ja: 自律ロボットが時空環境で観測対象（QoI）を監視する際、外部擾乱を考慮した効率的な計画手法を提案する。環境全体の擾乱推定は非効率なため、観測経路に沿った擾乱不確実性の低減を優先する2段階フレームワークを採用する。まず観測地点と代替経路を決定し、次に学習した擾乱信念を軌道最適化に組み込むことで、名目運動とは異なる実際の情報取得効率を最大化する。シミュレーションにより、環境全体推定比で25.0〜52.3%の擾乱学習時間短縮と、擾乱考慮下でより優れる経路の特定を実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: 軌道最適化と機械学習（擾乱推定）の組み合わせが関心に合致

papers.title: PUMA-Former: Uncertainty-Aware Agentic Computation Offloading in MEO-LEO Satellite Networks With Incomplete Information
papers.summary: Satellite edge computing distributes mobile workloads across moving processors whose service capacity must be coordinated over time. In medium Earth orbit (MEO)--low Earth orbit (LEO) networks, periodic reports leave CPU states stale or missing, making offloading sensitive to uncertain capacity and shared-destination congestion. We propose PUMA-Former, an uncertainty-aware agentic framework for cooperative offloading under incomplete information that balances completed work, service delay, and execution cost. A MEO coordinator maintains distinct-report memory and closes the loop between available evidence, capacity estimates, allocation commands, and execution feedback. Latent-delay attention weights plausible measurement-age hypotheses, and historical innovations refine CPU estimates around the latest received report. Queue-error-aware fusion incorporates auxiliary pressure while accounting for backlog uncertainty. The inferred resource moments condition a structured Transformer allocator for joint destination, partition, bandwidth, CPU, and power decisions. Bounded risk-aware calibration then adjusts workload splits to reflect uncertainty and shared destination load. In traffic-driven development evaluation, PUMA-Former increases admitted compute-work completion by 8.62%, reduces mean modeled service delay by 34.78%, and reduces mean episode-P95 delay by 71.08% relative to ATLA-adapt. It also improves completion and normalized energy over fixed-half round-robin offloading. Service gains over the learning baselines involve higher normalized energy.
papers.title_ja: PUMA-Former: 不完全情報下におけるMEO-LEO衛星ネットワークの不確実性認識エージェント型計算オフローディング
papers.summary_ja: MEO-LEO衛星ネットワークにおける計算オフローディングにおいて、CPU状態の報告遅延や欠損といった不確実性を考慮したエージェント型フレームワーク「PUMA-Former」を提案する。MEOコーディネータが異なる報告メモリを維持し、潜在遅延アテンションやキューエラー認識融合を用いて資源推定を精緻化する。推定された資源モーメントに基づき、構造化Transformerアロケータが宛先・分割・帯域幅・CPU・電力の決定を統合的に行う。評価により、完了ワークロードが8.62%向上し、平均サービス遅延が34.78%、P95遅延が71.08%削減されることを示した。

papers.title: Generative Design with Real-time Physics Explainability: Towards Product Definition in the Age of AI
papers.summary: In this article, we explore opportunities from using generative AI in mechanical engineering. On the one hand, generative methods based on invertible neural networks have been recently proposed for the solution of inverse design problems, allowing to infer design parameters from performance labels. On the other hand, generative AI models have shown that they can act as real time capable surrogates for physics based simulations. Here we suggest that these two streams should be combined in a unified framework, where INN are used to control the design process from the customer requirements perspective and the generative simulation of the systems physics adds a layer of explainability, why the proposed design fulfils the requirements. As generative design is prone to hallucinations, we propose uncertainty quantification to fend off physically infeasible requests. Finally, validation with classical tools is a requirement for generative design process. To demonstrate the capabilities of our novel generative design paradigm, we develop two interactive environments, one for airfoil design based on simulator data and one for the combustor design space exploration based on measured data.
papers.title_ja: リアルタイム物理説明可能性を備えた生成設計：AI時代の製品定義へ
papers.summary_ja: 可逆ニューラルネットワーク（INN）による逆設計と、物理シミュレーションのリアルタイムサロゲートモデルを統合した生成設計フレームワークを提案する。INNで顧客要件から設計パラメータを推定し、生成AIによる物理シミュレーションでその妥当性を説明可能にする。ハルシネーション対策として不確実性定量化を導入し、物理的に不可能な要求を排除する。翼型設計と燃焼器設計の2つのインタラクティブ環境で実証した。

papers.title: Antidistillation is Cheap: Lightweight Distillation-Resistance via Stylistic Corruption
papers.summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) is a highly effective paradigm for transferring capabilities from large language models (LLMs) to smaller, more specialized student models. In commercial deployment where frontier models are restricted behind black-box APIs, sequence-level distillation remains a potent vector for competitors to clone proprietary capabilities at a fraction of the development cost. Existing defenses mostly rely on surrogate models to manipulate next-token sampling, which increases computational overhead and real-time inference latency. In this work, we propose a lightweight defense that dynamically injects style-steering vectors into the teacher model's activations upon malicious queries. This framework offers exceptional flexibility, allowing hosts to customize target defensive styles and dynamically blend them to maximize stylistic variance. Crucially, this inference-time intervention preserves semantic utility and fluency during malicious queries, misleading adversaries into believing that they are extracting pristine teacher outputs, while standard consumers continue to receive original, unmodified responses. Our experiments demonstrate that this framework successfully disrupts student learning, achieving substantial anti-distillation performance while incurring negligible overhead and preserving text naturalness. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/distill-resist-38C6/.
papers.title_ja: アンチディストリレーションは安価である：スタイル破損による軽量な蒸留耐性
papers.summary_ja: 大規模言語モデル（LLM）の知識蒸留による能力窃取を防ぐための軽量な防御手法を提案する。既存のサロゲートモデルを用いた防御が計算負荷とレイテンシを増大させる問題に対し、本手法は悪意あるクエリ検出時に教師モデルの活性化にスタイル誘導ベクトルを動的に注入する。これにより、意味的有用性と流暢性を保ったまま出力スタイルを乱し、競合が純粋な教師出力を得たと誤認させることで学習を妨害する。実験では、推論時の介入でありながら計算オーバーヘッドを最小限に抑えつつ、高いアンチディストリレーション性能とテキストの自然さを両立することを示した。

papers.title: New Closed-Form Approximations in Statistical Mechanics Obtained by Symbolic Regression
papers.summary: Obtaining accurate and analytically tractable closed-form expressions for complex physical systems remains a fundamental challenge in statistical mechanics. In this work, we investigate three approximation problems in polymer statistical mechanics using two complementary symbolic regression frameworks: Deep Symbolic Optimization (DSO), based on reinforcement learning, and PyOperon, based on genetic programming with nonlinear least-squares constant optimization. First, for the force-extension relationship of the Worm-Like Chain (WLC) model, DSO achieves a maximum relative error below 0.15%, while PyOperon reduces it to 0.05%, outperforming the Marko-Siggia formula (approximately 17%) and the Petrosyan approximation. Second, for the logarithmic factorial, ln(n!), both frameworks recover the dominant structure of Stirling's formula directly from analytical data. Using residual learning on a continued-fraction expansion of the Stirling remainder, PyOperon reduces the maximum relative error by a factor of 1.3 x 10^4 compared with the most accurate of nine classical approximations for n in [1, 30]. Third, for the non-Gaussian radial probability density of the Freely Jointed Chain (FJC) model, physics-informed residual learning improves the approximation by factors of 11.2 over Darabi et al. (2023) and 4.6 over the steepest-descent approximation. The discovered expressions remain analytically tractable across all three applications. These results demonstrate the complementary capabilities of DSO and PyOperon for discovering accurate closed-form approximations in statistical and continuum mechanics.
papers.title_ja: シンボリック回帰を用いた統計力学における新しい閉形式近似
papers.summary_ja: 強化学習ベースのDSOと遺伝的アルゴリズムベースのPyOperonという2つのシンボリック回帰フレームワークを用い、高分子統計力学の3つの近似問題を解いた。WLCモデルの力-伸長関係、対数階乗、FJCモデルの非ガウス型確率密度関数について、既存の古典的近似式よりも高精度な閉形式表現を発見した。特に、物理情報残差学習により、FJCモデルの近似精度を大幅に向上させた。これらは複雑な物理系に対して解析的に扱いやすく、かつ高精度な近似式を自動発見する手法の有効性を示している。

papers.title: See Every Block Once: Variance-Reduced Post-Training for Masked Diffusion Language Models
papers.summary: Policy gradient methods are widely used to align large language model outputs with human preferences, but the log-likelihoods they require cannot be directly computed in Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs). MDLM post-training therefore relies on a surrogate objective based on the Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO), and recent work estimates a blockwise variant of this objective via Monte Carlo methods to support blockwise generation. However, existing estimation schemes randomly sample the block index, so they may evaluate the same block more than once and leave some blocks unevaluated. This introduces variance arising from block selection into the estimates. In this work, we propose a full-block estimator that evaluates every block exactly once and averages the results. We theoretically show that the proposed estimator remains unbiased while eliminating the between-group variance arising from block selection, thereby achieving lower variance than the baseline for the same sample size. In experiments on five benchmarks spanning mathematics, planning, and coding, our method achieves the highest accuracy on four benchmarks and outperforms the random block sampling baseline by an average of 12.79 points.
papers.title_ja: すべてのブロックを一度だけ見る：マスク拡散言語モデルのための分散低減ポストトレーニング
papers.summary_ja: マスク拡散言語モデル（MDLM）のポストトレーニングにおいて、モンテカルロ法によるELBO推定で生じるブロック選択の分散を低減する手法を提案する。既存手法がランダムサンプリングによりブロックの重複評価や未評価を引き起こす問題に対し、全ブロックをちょうど一度ずつ評価して平均化するフルブロック推定器を導入した。理論的に無偏性を保ちつつブロック間分散を除去できることを示し、数学・計画・コーディングの5つのベンチマークで平均12.79ポイントの性能向上を実証した。

papers.title: Convergence analysis of physics-informed neural networks for subdiffusion
papers.summary: Physics-informed neural networks have emerged as mesh-free solvers for partial differential equations, yet their rigorous convergence theory for time-fractional problems remains limited. We present a convergence analysis of PINNs for linear subdiffusion equations and for the associated backward problem of recovering the initial data from terminal observations. To address the nonlocality and weakly singular kernels of fractional derivatives, we introduce a discretization-based PINN framework built on some popular time-stepping schemes satisfying discrete maximal regularity, including backward Euler, BDF2, L1, and fractional CN schemes. This approach avoids the exact evaluation of fractional derivatives at training points while preserving the stability structure needed for convergence analysis. For the forward problem, we prove that, under the natural fractional maximal-regularity condition $u\in W^{\alpha,p}(0,T;L^2(\Omega))\cap L^p(0,T;H^2(\Omega)\cap H_0^1(\Omega))$, the piecewise linear temporal reconstructions of PINN-loss minimizers converge to the exact solution. This result avoids the higher-order regularity assumptions on the exact solution that are often imposed in existing PINN convergence analyses. We also verify the required discrete maximal regularity and consistency properties for the aforementioned popular time discretizations. We then extend the analysis to the backward subdiffusion problem and establish convergence of the regularized recovery of the initial data from terminal observations, despite its ill-posedness. Numerical experiments for both forward and backward problems support the theoretical results, demonstrate the necessity of regularization, and show that $L^2$-type losses alone are generally insufficient. These results establish a rigorous theoretical basis for discretization-based PINNs for time-fractional diffusion problems.
papers.title_ja: サブディフージョンにおける物理情報ニューラルネットワークの収束解析
papers.summary_ja: 時間分数微分方程式（サブディフージョン）に対する物理情報ニューラルネットワーク（PINN）の収束性を厳密に解析した。離散化ベースの枠組みを用い、後方オイラー法やBDF2法などの時間ステップスキームが満たす離散最大正則性を活用することで、分数微分の非局所性や弱特異性を扱いながら収束性を証明した。前方問題だけでなく、逆問題である初期データの復元についても、正則化を伴う収束性を確立した。数値実験により、理論結果の妥当性と正則化の必要性、およびL2損失単独の限界を実証している。

papers.title: Federated Physics-Informed Thermal Field Prediction Across Unseen Geometries in Distributed Additive Manufacturing
papers.summary: In additive manufacturing (AM), each change in part geometry requires a new thermal simulation, which makes design evaluation over many candidates costly. Geometry-aware models reduce this cost by predicting thermal fields on unseen parts with a single learned model, but they assume that diverse geometries are available centrally. This assumption is restrictive when each manufacturing site holds only a limited set of proprietary part designs that it cannot share. We propose Fed-PIGANO, a federated framework that trains physics-informed geometry-aware neural operator (PI-GANO) models at individual sites and aggregates their geometry encoders and prediction networks without sharing part geometries. We evaluate the framework on a 2D steady-state thermal benchmark for metal AM, with geometries from five polygonal families distributed across three sites under four scenarios that range from identical to strongly different family compositions. Over seven replications, Fed-PIGANO achieves mean relative L2 errors of 1.83% to 2.04% across all 12 scenario-site cases, compared with up to 20.46% for local-only training, and consistently yields lower PDE residuals. Its prediction accuracy is comparable to that of a centralized model trained on the pooled geometries of all sites. These results demonstrate that federated learning lets manufacturing sites benefit from each other's geometries without sharing them, enabling rapid thermal prediction on new part designs for tasks such as shape optimization, inverse design, and uncertainty quantification.
papers.title_ja: 分散型増材製造における未見幾何学に対する連合物理情報熱場予測
papers.summary_ja: 増材製造における熱場シミュレーションの計算コスト削減を目的とし、物理情報ニューラルオペレータ（PI-GANO）を用いた連合学習フレームワーク Fed-PIGANO を提案する。各製造サイトが保有する非公開の部品幾何学を共有せずに、幾何エンコーダと予測ネットワークのみを集約することで、未見の幾何学に対する高精度な熱場予測を実現する。金属AMの2D定常熱伝導ベンチマークにおいて、ローカル学習比で最大20%超の誤差を低減し、中央集約型モデルと同等の精度を達成した。この手法は、形状最適化や逆設計など、多様な幾何学を扱う実務的な設計評価プロセスの高速化に貢献する。

papers.title: Enrichment-Oriented Virtual Screening of Perovskite Solar Cells through Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Experimental optimization of perovskite solar cells is constrained by combinatorial diversity in absorber compositions, device layers, and processing, which makes virtual screening attractive for prioritizing recipes before fabrication. We develop a surrogate-guided reinforcement-learning framework that casts recipe generation as virtual screening, enriching candidate shortlists near high-performing experimental neighbors. A frozen Tabular Prior-data Fitted Network (TabPFN) guides recipe generation, while a reference pool of 890 measured devices enables neighborhood-based assessment. Five-fold evaluation on 1,846 devices shows top-ten selection raises mean power conversion efficiency (PCE) from 19.68\% to 23.74\%. Three learned policies are compared with six baselines under 3,000 surrogate evaluations per run. In top-100 shortlists, Proximal policy optimization (PPO) and recurrent PPO (RPPO) achieve neighborhood-supported hit rates of 23\% and 24\% (7.9- and 8.3-fold Pure Random's 2.9\%), versus 10\% (3.4-fold) for the baselines with the highest supported hit rate (L-SHADE and Ax BO, tied) at $K = 100$. Gains coexist with weak-support fractions. Of 9,000 recipes, 65.4\% match a composition family at similarity 0.80, falling to 11.7\% at 0.90. Results support enrichment-oriented prioritization but not experimental performance, seed robustness, or matched-budget advantage.
papers.title_ja: 強化学習によるペロブスカイト太陽電池の富化指向型バーチャルスクリーニング
papers.summary_ja: ペロブスカイト太陽電池のレシピ生成をバーチャルスクリーニングとして捉え、サロゲートモデルと強化学習（RL）を組み合わせたフレームワークを提案する。TabPFNをサロゲートとして用い、近傍の高性能実験データに基づいて候補を富化させる手法である。PPOやRPPOなどのRLエージェントを用いることで、ランダム選択やベイズ最適化ベースラインと比較し、トップ100候補中のヒット率を大幅に向上させた。ただし、高類似度での構成一致率は低く、実験性能の保証やシード頑健性には限界があることも示された。

papers.title: Securing Multi-Agent Systems by Design
papers.summary: Multi-agent systems solve complex tasks by decomposing them into subtasks, delegating the subtasks to agents, and aggregating the agents' responses using an aggregation rule. Malicious agents can manipulate the final solution by providing malicious responses to their assigned subtasks. In this paper, we first propose response manipulation attacks (ReMA), which iteratively optimize malicious responses to maximize attack effectiveness. Specifically, we formulate untargeted and targeted attacks as optimization problems and develop an approach to approximately solve these problems by iteratively refining malicious responses based on feedback from a surrogate multi-agent system. To defend against such attacks, we further propose SecMAS, a secure aggregation rule that leverages the semantic similarities among agent responses to select the response that is most consistent with a sufficiently large subset of the other responses. We theoretically establish security guarantees for SecMAS against both untargeted and targeted attacks. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that existing aggregation rules are vulnerable to ReMA, whereas SecMAS effectively defends against all evaluated attacks, including adaptive variants of ReMA, while maintaining utility comparable to that of existing aggregation rules.
papers.title_ja: 設計段階からマルチエージェントシステムを保護する
papers.summary_ja: マルチエージェントシステムにおける悪意あるエージェントによる回答操作攻撃（ReMA）を提案し、サロゲートモデルを用いた反復最適化で攻撃手法を構築した。これに対し、エージェント間回答のセマンティック類似性を活用して安全な集約ルール（SecMAS）を設計し、理論的なセキュリティ保証を導出した。既存ルールは脆弱である一方、SecMAS は攻撃に対して有効に防御しつつ、ユーティリティを維持することを評価で示した。

papers.title: A systematic comparison of physics-informed neural networks and mechanistic models for epidemic modeling and forecasting
papers.summary: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have recently been applied to epidemic modeling and forecasting with promising results. These methods integrate mechanistic knowledge with data-driven learning. Yet, their comparative performance against well-established, and simpler epidemic models is underexplored. Here, we conduct a systematic comparison of a PINN-based framework and a stochastic mechanistic model. Both approaches share the same age-structured SEIRD core and rolling-window forecasting pipeline, in a deliberately minimal setting. We evaluate their retrospective fits and probabilistic forecasts in two synthetic scenarios and the first COVID-19 wave in London. Interestingly, while PINNs underperform in synthetic scenarios, they achieve better performance on real data. Furthermore, PINNs provide narrower uncertainty intervals and sharper estimation of parameters in synthetic scenarios. Our findings confirm PINNs as a promising tool in epidemiology. At the same time, the results reaffirm the value of simpler approaches such as traditional compartmental models, and promote additional benchmarking studies.
papers.title_ja: 疫学モデリングと予測における物理情報ニューラルネットワークとメカニスティックモデルの体系的比較
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、疫学モデリングにおいて物理情報ニューラルネットワーク（PINN）と確率的メカニスティックモデルの性能を体系的に比較する。両者は同じ年齢構造SEIRDコアと予測パイプラインを共有する最小限の設定で、合成シナリオとロンドンの実際のCOVID-19第1波データを用いて評価した。結果として、PINNは合成データでは劣るものの実データでは高性能を示し、不確実性の区間も狭いことが確認された。これらの知見は、PINNが疫学における有望なツールであることを示す一方、従来の区画モデルのような単純な手法の価値とさらなるベンチマーク研究の必要性を再確認するものである。

papers.title: Kronecker Approximations of Covariance Matrices for Solving Inverse Problems
papers.summary: Inverse problems arise in many applications where the task is to recover unknown parameters from indirect or noisy observations. In contrast to forward problems, where outputs are directly computed from known inputs, inverse problems are designed to infer the underlying variables from the observed effect. Inverse problems are often ill-posed, so regularization is needed to compute reasonable solutions. One form of regularization incorporates prior knowledge about the unknown parameters in the form of prior distributions. However, in many settings, large prior covariance matrices pose computational bottlenecks for solving inverse problems. To address this, we study approximations of large covariance matrices via structured Kronecker-Toeplitz products and demonstrate how these approximations can be used to solve inverse problems. We exploit the Block-Toeplitz-Toeplitz-Block structure induced by the covariance kernel to construct compact approximations that are orders of magnitude cheaper to store and invert. These approximations are deployed as prior covariance surrogates in Bayesian inverse problems solved via generalized hybrid iterative methods. We demonstrate that the Kronecker-Toeplitz approximation attains lower relative approximation error than existing matrix approximations, exhibits rapid error decay with rank, and enables efficient matrix-vector products. Applications to 2D seismic tomography reconstruction problems illustrate the practical utility of these methods.
papers.title_ja: 逆問題の解法における共分散行列のクロネッカー近似
papers.summary_ja: 逆問題における大きな事前共分散行列の計算コストを削減するため、ブロック・トーplitz構造を利用したクロネッカー積による近似手法を提案する。この近似は既存手法よりも低い相対誤差とランクに対する急速な誤差減衰を示し、行列積の計算を高速化する。ベイズ逆問題の汎化ハイブリッド反復法に適用し、2次元地震トモグラフィー再構成において実用的な有効性を検証した。

papers.title: Active flow control based on topological data analysis and a DMDc reduced-order model for drag reduction
papers.summary: Controlling and reducing undesirable vortical structures in unsteady flows is a major issue in aerodynamics. This paper presents an active control methodology that combines topological data analysis (TDA) through persistence diagrams, a reduced-order model based on dynamic mode decomposition with control (DMDc) and receding-horizon model predictive control (MPC). Vortices are detected and characterised by the persistence diagram of the absolute value of the vorticity, which makes it possible to define a target flow in which only the useful vortices are retained. This target flow is computed offline in the reduced space by gradient descent, the derivative of a persistence diagram being defined through a parametrisation of the space of diagrams. The control loop then reduces to a small-dimensional convex quadratic program, whose construction we detail and whose cost we compare with that of an approach that places the diagrams directly in the cost function. The approach is applied numerically to the flow around an oscillating aircraft wing for seven vibration frequencies, and yields a mean reduction of the drag coefficient while preserving the main vortices.
papers.title_ja: トポロジカルデータ解析とDMDc縮約モデルに基づく抗力低減のための能動流制御
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、トポロジカルデータ解析（TDA）と制御付き動的モード分解（DMDc）による縮約モデル、およびモデル予測制御（MPC）を組み合わせた能動流制御手法を提案する。渦の検出と特徴付けには絶対値の渦度の持続性図を用い、有用な渦のみを残す目標流をオフラインで計算する。制御ループは低次元の凸二次計画問題に帰着し、振動する航空機翼周りの流れに対して適用することで、主要な渦を維持しつつ抗力係数を平均的に低減できることを数値的に示した。

papers.title: A Machine-learning-aided Workflow for Sampling Small Polaron Dynamics in Energy Materials
papers.summary: One of the defining characteristics of most energy materials, used as e.g.~battery electrodes, photovoltaics, or photocatalysts, is their ability conduct charges such as electrons and holes. The exact mechanism of this conductivity depends on the material, but is often dominated by the existence of mobile small polarons, i.e.~electrons or holes strongly localised through the polarisation of their environment. Computationally, small polarons can be treated with reasonably accuracy through the use of self-interaction corrected or hybrid density functional theory (DFT) together with local geometry optimisation. Similar approaches can be employed to determine the energy barriers to movement of the polarons through hopping. Unfortunately, realistic energy materials tend have very large numbers of symmetry inequivalent polaronic configurations and correspondingly large numbers of hopping barriers, making them hard to tackle explicitly. In this work we therefore extend the computational reach of DFT calculations with machine-learned (ML) surrogate models, which then feed into a kinetic model to quantitatively estimate the conductivity of a battery anode material (Li$_4$Ti$_5$O$_12$ or LTO) at realistic, defected conditions. We calculate the conductivity at room temperature to be 6.7 $\times$ 10$^{-3}$ S/cm which lies well in the experimental range. To this end, we only needed a total of 154 polaron barrier calculations, out of 3649 symmetry inequivalent ones, achieving an over 20-fold increase of computational efficiency. Overall, our work demonstrates how DFT-trained ML surrogates can be used to quantitatively and efficiently sample the dynamics of small polarons in energy materials.
papers.title_ja: エネルギー材料における小ポラロン動態サンプリングのための機械学習支援ワークフロー
papers.summary_ja: エネルギー材料における小ポラロンの伝導メカニズムを、DFT計算と機械学習サロゲートモデルの組み合わせで効率的に解析する手法を提案する。3649個の非対称配置のうち154個の計算のみで、リチウムイオン電池負極材料（LTO）の室温伝導度を実験値と整合する形で定量評価した。これにより計算効率を20倍以上向上させ、欠陥を含む現実的な条件下でのポラロン動態サンプリングを可能にした。

papers.title: Alignment with Reflect-Reasoning: Learning How To Follow Principles
papers.summary: The appropriate governing norms and principles for the alignment of Large Language Models (LLMs) often depend on cultural context and deployment application. However, most alignment techniques focus on training models to conform to human preferences or constitutional principles specified at training time and subsequently fixed. In practice, many deployers rely on system prompting to implement contextual norms and guardrails at inference time. Prior work has shown that post-generation reflective reasoning with critique and revision can improve conformance compared to simple system prompting, but such methods are limited to the reasoning abilities inherent in the trained model. We introduce Reflect-Reasoning, a training method that teaches models how to reason about alignment to principles, rather than simply which principles to follow. Across five models, Reflect-Reasoning consistently outperforms both system prompting and explicit prompting strategies for in-context reflective reasoning. These improvements extend and generalize to entirely out-of-distribution domains of medical and financial principles. We additionally demonstrate that Reflect-Reasoning reduces the occurrence of rare but serious principle violations. Finally, we show that Reflect-Reasoning does not erode the safety engineering of a model and is robust against jailbreaking attempts using adversarial constitutions. Overall, our results demonstrate that Reflect-Reasoning is a scalable method for training constitutional alignment as a generalizable reasoning capability, enabling models to adapt to novel principles and produce transparent reasoning traces without additional fine-tuning.
papers.title_ja: Reflect-Reasoning によるアライメント：原則に従うための学習
papers.summary_ja: 大規模言語モデル（LLM）の対話品質を高めるため、単に原則を記憶させるのではなく、原則について推論する能力を学習させる「Reflect-Reasoning」という手法を提案する。この手法は、システムプロンプトや明示的なプロンプト戦略よりも一貫して優れたパフォーマンスを発揮し、医療や金融など分布外（OOD）の分野でも汎用性を示す。さらに、重大な原則違反の発生を低減し、安全性エンジニアリングを損なわずに敵対的攻撃（ジェイルブレイク）に対して頑健であることも実証された。これにより、追加のファインチューニングなしで新しい原則に適応し、透明な推論トレースを生成できるスケーラブルなアライメント手法となる。

papers.title: Unfinished-Bench: Measuring Rule Violations by Persistent Agents in Realistic Work Environments
papers.summary: AI agents are increasingly equipped with persistence toward task completion to run delegated work autonomously for long periods, under many unstated constraints from internal documents and other people's authority. When completion requires violating a rule, the agent must decide alone, yet benchmarks of instruction-rule conflicts state the rule in the prompt or keep it hidden and do not evaluate persistence. We present Unfinished-Bench, a benchmark that gives models persistence in autonomous runs without a user, in realistic work environments with embedded rules. In each of its 97 scenarios across 7 organizations and 7 risk categories, the goal and the rule cannot both hold. We find that persistence raised violations of a rule in an internal document from 32.2% to 43.6%, five times the 8.5% for the same rule stated by the user. Of the document-rule violations, 98.3% occurred after the rule was displayed, and in 89% of a judged sample the agent first wrote down the rule. Violations of rules placed in the environment without user oversight can lead to serious incidents, so persistence-driven risks need to be evaluated. Benchmark documentation: https://francis21c.github.io/unfinished-bench/
papers.title_ja: Unfinished-Bench: 現実的な業務環境における永続エージェントのルール違反測定

papers.title: Creating Steering Vectors via Input Optimisation
papers.summary: Activation steering influences a language model's behaviour by adding a steering vector to its residual stream during generation, but it requires white-box access to modify the hidden states at every generation step. We introduce ActGCG, a modification of Greedy Coordinate Gradient which optimises a suffix to match the target activations obtained by adding a steering vector to the residual stream. We further introduce universal suffixes trained across many prompts at once, a model-translation step that rewrites the suffix into human-readable text midway through optimisation, and a soft-suffix variant to remove the discrete token space constraint. We study two behaviours: steering a model to answer in German, and anti-refusal steering for jailbreaking. For German, a discrete suffix reproduces the steering vector's behaviour almost perfectly and transfers well across prompts and models. For anti-refusal, the equivalence is weaker, succeeding under a phrase-avoidance metric but only partially under the stricter HarmBench classifier. Our results show that a steering vector's behaviour is reachable from the input, with no access to model internals at generation time, up to a loss that depends on the concept being steered.
papers.title_ja: 入力最適化によるステアリングベクトルの作成
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、LLMの内部状態（アクティベーション）に直接アクセスせずに、入力テキスト（サフィックス）を最適化することでモデルの挙動を制御する手法「ActGCG」を提案する。Greedy Coordinate Gradientを改良し、目標とするアクティベーションパターンを再現するサフィックスを生成し、さらに人間が読めるテキストへの変換や離散トークン制約の緩和を行う。ドイツ語での回答誘導や拒否回避（ジェイルブレイク）の2つのシナリオで検証し、入力側からの制御が内部状態操作と同等の効果を持つことを示した。

papers.title: Benchmarks Don't Talk Back: Learning Through Self-Disagreement
papers.summary: A benchmark usually measures a language model alone with a question, and deployment rarely looks like that: answers get contested, and models give up correct ones under counter-reasoning that is itself wrong. We show that what fails there is not a shortfall of accuracy but a capability in its own right -- knowing when to hold a position and when to yield to a better one -- which we call dialectical competence. It stands on first-answer accuracy without following from it: a model can be made materially better at answering and no better at this, and training for accuracy alone can drift against it. Nor can it be bought at inference, by self-reflection or by sampling more. Taking a cue from the dialectical tradition in philosophy, in which productive opposition arises within a position rather than being imposed on it from outside, we hypothesize that this capability can be trained from opposition the model supplies itself. It states a position, generates the strongest case against that position -- its antithesis -- rules on whether the case stands, and is trained on that ruling, with no second model at training or at deployment. We call this learning through Self-Disagreement: reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards throughout, where the same check that scores an answer against its reference scores the ruling too, so no reward model, no preference data and no human annotation enter anywhere. The capability is trained rather than elicited: weak in the base model, it arrives with the reward, is not paid for out of first-answer accuracy, and holds against challengers the model never trained against, including ones stronger than itself. The opposition a model needs in order to improve, it turns out, need not come from outside it.
papers.title_ja: ベンチマークは反論しない：自己不一致を通じた学習
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、LLMが誤った反論に対して正解を譲ってしまう「弁証的コンピテンシー」の欠如を指摘し、これを改善する手法を提案する。モデル自身が自分の主張に対する最有力な反論（反題）を生成し、その妥当性を判定するプロセスを強化学習で訓練することで、外部モデルや報酬モデルなしに能力を向上させる。この手法は初回回答の精度を犠牲にせず、訓練時に遭遇しなかったより強力な挑戦者に対しても有効であることが示された。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの推論・評価手法の革新であり、実務的なハルシネーション対策に直結する

papers.title: Offline KL-Regularized Reinforcement Learning with Stochastic Transitions
papers.summary: KL-regularized reinforcement learning is the objective behind RL fine-tuning of language models, and its data are often collected by the reference policy itself. However, beyond bandits and deterministic transitions, little is known about how much offline data it needs. In this work, we study finite discounted Markov decision processes with unknown stochastic transitions, $K$ state-action pairs and effective horizon $H$. For data that cover the regularized optimum with concentrability $C\geq 4$, every estimator needs $\Omega(KCH^3/(\epsilon\max\{\epsilon,\beta\}))$ samples on some instances when $\epsilon$ is small, where $\beta$ is the temperature. Under a fixed design, pessimistic soft value iteration with a variance-aware penalty attains this rate with high probability, up to logarithmic factors, when $\beta\geq 1.4H$. When the data come from the reference policy itself, we show that it covers the optimum up to a power law whose exponent grows as $H/\beta$; in the same temperature range, this power law alone gives the estimator a sample complexity polynomial in $1/\epsilon$, with no coverage assumption. For $\beta\geq H$ the power can also increase the sample size needed by a factor polynomial in $1/\epsilon$. Finally, the plug-in estimator, which is minimax optimal with a generative model, can fail on reference data at small temperatures when many actions are rarely seen, while the pessimistic estimator does not.
papers.title_ja: 確率的遷移を持つオフラインKL正則化強化学習
papers.summary_ja: LLMのRLファインチューニングの基盤となるKL正則化強化学習において、確率的遷移を持つ有限MDPでのサンプル複雑性を理論的に分析した。集中可能性（concentrability）を仮定した場合の下限と、悲観的ソフト価値反復法による達成可能性を示した。さらに、参照ポリシーから収集したデータでは、温度パラメータとホライズンの関係に基づき、カバレッジ仮定なしで多項式オーダーのサンプル複雑性を保証する結果を得た。プラグイン推定量が低温域で失敗し得る一方、悲観的推定量が頑健であることを示し、オフラインRLの設計指針を提示している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM効率化と強化学習手法の両方に深く関連する理論的貢献

papers.title: More Agents, More Samples, or More Thinking? Untangling Coordination, Ensembling, and Test-Time Compute in Multi-Agent LLMs
papers.summary: Evaluations of multi-agent language models often compare communicating architectures against a single greedy pass. This practice confounds coordination with sample multiplicity and inference compute. We synthesize nine primary empirical evaluations comprising 516 unique multi-agent configurations organized along a resource vector R with six dimensions and a baseline ladder with four categories. Against baselines with a single pass (Category A), multi-agent accuracy differences are negative overall and near zero when omitting the largest contributing study. When evaluated against baselines matched on sample count (Category B) or resource budget (Category C), multi-agent systems average -0.042 in accuracy, and multilevel random effects modeling on the log odds scale remains negative across sensitivity checks. Multi-agent accuracy equals or falls below the baseline in 74% of these comparable contrasts, and study means are nonpositive in almost all evaluated studies. Across studies reporting both baselines, moving from a greedy pass to a sampled baseline shifts accuracy differences by -0.038 on average. Because communication adds no information when agents share identical evidence, positive returns require partitioned evidence, external verification, or error diversity across models. We provide a reviewer checklist and accounting utilities.
papers.title_ja: エージェント数、サンプル数、思考量？マルチエージェントLLMにおける協調、アンサンブル、テスト時計算の解明
papers.summary_ja: マルチエージェントLLMの評価において、協調（コミュニケーション）とサンプル数・計算資源の増加が混同されている問題を指摘する。9つの主要な実証評価（516構成）を統合し、サンプル数やリソース予算を揃えたベースラインと比較した。その結果、マルチエージェントシステムは精度が平均-0.042と劣り、74%のケースでベースライン以下であった。エージェント間での情報共有だけでは利益が得られず、証拠の分割や外部検証、モデル間のエラー多様性が正の収益に必要であると結論づけている。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と評価手法の最適化に直結する重要な知見

papers.title: AscendGYM: A Cost-Aware Kernel Optimization Benchmark for Real-World Workloads on Ascend NPUs
papers.summary: Kernel optimization is essential for efficient large language model (LLM) training and inference on Ascend NPUs. Existing Ascend kernel benchmarks primarily focus on kernel generation, with less emphasis on the ability of agents to optimize existing implementations under input configurations drawn from real workloads. To address this requirement, we introduce AscendGYM, a benchmark whose initial suite comprises 48 kernels across three difficulty levels. Each kernel is paired with test cases whose data types and tensor shapes are collected from real-world training and inference tasks. Consequently, performance improvements on AscendGYM map directly to the corresponding workloads. In terms of usability, two evaluation modes are supported in AscendGYM: model evaluation and model-harness evaluation. The kernel optimization capabilities of both trained models and custom agents are allowed to be measured. It provides a complete execution environment that closely reproduces how Ascend kernels are invoked in practical pipelines. For model evaluation, it additionally includes a built-in harness equipped with search orchestration and experience accumulation. Finally, we propose a new metric, the Speedup-Token Score (STS), which quantifies performance gains relative to token cost. By jointly considering speedup and cost, STS enables the assessment of practical kernel optimization capability of a model or harness under an acceptable budget. AscendGYM is available at https://github.com/SLAI-AITP/AscendGYM.
papers.title_ja: AscendGYM: Ascend NPU における実ワークロード向けのコスト意識型カーネル最適化ベンチマーク
papers.summary_ja: Ascend NPU 上の LLM 推論・学習効率化を目的としたカーネル最適化ベンチマーク「AscendGYM」を提案する。実ワークロード由来のデータ型やテンソル形状を用いた 48 種のカーネルで構成され、既存実装の最適化能力を評価する。モデル評価とエージェント評価の 2 モードに対応し、実パイプラインに近い実行環境を提供する。さらに、速度向上とトークンコストの両方を考慮した新指標「Speedup-Token Score (STS)」を導入し、予算制約下での実用的な最適化性能を定量化する。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM 推論高速化とエージェント設計、評価手法の関心に直結

papers.title: Logically Consistent Accurate Forecasts
papers.summary: Agentic forecasting systems based on large language models (LLMs) are now competitive with expert human forecasters, but these systems still suffer from a critical limitation: the inability to produce forecasts that are logically consistent. For example, forecasts for related events often fail to satisfy the axioms of probability, which in turn implies that related forecasts cannot simultaneously be correct and undermines their utility for decision makers. Enforcing consistency is not trivial -- naive approaches (e.g., projection onto the set of consistent forecasts) can degrade accuracy. We argue that the key to overcoming the apparent tradeoff between consistency and accuracy lies in the reasoning which supports each forecast. We finetune a supervisory language model that leverages this reasoning to jointly reconcile inconsistencies while improving the accuracy of related forecasts. On ForecastBench, our method improves the Brier score of a retrieval-augmented GPT-5.1 forecaster by 9.3% while reducing measures of structural inconsistency by 82-90%. We interrogate our method via a comprehensive series of baselines and ablations, and find that no alternative method matches our gains in consistency and accuracy simultaneously.
papers.title_ja: 論理的に整合的で正確な予測
papers.summary_ja: LLMベースの予測システムにおいて、関連イベント間の確率論的整合性を保ちつつ精度を向上させる手法を提案する。単純な射影手法では精度が低下する問題に対し、各予測を支える推論過程を活用する監督型言語モデルをファインチューニングすることで、不一致の調整と精度改善を同時に実現した。ForecastBenchでの評価において、RAG拡張GPT-5.1のBrierスコアを9.3%改善し、構造的な不一致を82〜90%削減した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論・RAG・評価ベンチマークの関心に直結

papers.title: Natural Swing-Up of an Underpowered Double Pendulum
papers.summary: Robots with weak motors must ride their natural dynamics rather than fight them. We swing up a direct-drive planar two-link robot, whose motors deliver only about 6\,\% of its shoulder gravity torque, along its nonlinear normal modes, two-dimensional invariant manifolds consisting of periodic orbits. On a non-strict mode, injecting energy necessarily moves the state off the manifold, so pumping and stabilization compete for the same bounded torque. We split the input torque into a power-neutral steering component and a scalar pumping input, the only component that changes the energy. The allocation then becomes a linear program in two variables: maximize pumping subject to the torque limits and one control-Lyapunov constraint. The constraint uses the model-based rate of the error, so no stabilizing feedback gain is needed. Experiments in hardware show swing-ups along both modes and compare the allocation with summing-and-clipping and with prioritized stabilization.
papers.title_ja: 低出力ダブルペンダルによる自然なスイングアップ
papers.summary_ja: モーター出力が重力トルクの約6%しかない低出力ロボットアームのスイングアップ制御手法を提案する。非線形正規モードに沿ったエネルギー注入と安定化を、線形計画問題として定式化し、トルク制限下で効率的な入力配分を行う。モデルベースの誤差変化率を用いることで、安定化フィードバックゲインを不要にし、ハードウェア実験でその有効性を検証した。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習やML手法ではなく、古典制御理論と最適化に基づく研究であるため

papers.title: On the Existence of a Third Planet and an Apsidal Resonance Chain in the Kepler-396 System through TESS Data
papers.summary: The possible existence of a third planet in the Kepler-396 system has been previously proposed. Given that the planetary mass is poorly constrained and the orbit could be either interior or exterior to planet Kepler-396 c, that proposal is not clearly known in the community. In order to address this and further investigate Kepler-396 system's configuration, new TESS data are employed to form a long baseline of transit timing. Using the pixel-level decorrelation technique, the mid-transit times are determined. Through long baseline transit-timing-variation technique, we perform a comprehensive exploration of the parameter space of the third planet. Two best-fit solutions, derived from different priors of orbital inclinations, have led to the reduced chi-square values as 2.24 and 2.34 respectively, compared to 12.97 for the two-planet model. This result strongly suggests the existence of the third planet, i.e. Kepler-396 d. Based on these two best-fit solutions, the masses of Kepler-396 b, c, d are updated to be around 9, 4, 4 Earth Mass, and the corresponding orbital periods are 43, 89, 144 days, respectively. With these updated masses, Kepler-396 b is on the border between rocky or volatile-rich, Kepler-396 c is confirmed to be a volatile-rich super-puff planet, and both planets lie in the Neptune savanna. Dynamical simulations with three planets are performed, showing that they are stable for a timescale of $10^6$ years. The examination on resonant angles leads to the conclusion that planets Kepler-396 b, c, d form a three-body apsidal resonance chain.
papers.title_ja: TESSデータを用いたケプラー-396系における第3惑星の存在とアプシダル共鳴チェーンの存在について
papers.summary_ja: TESSデータを用いたトランジットタイミング変動（TTV）解析により、ケプラー-396系に第3惑星（Kepler-396 d）が存在することを強く示唆した。2惑星モデルと比較して残差が大幅に改善され、3惑星モデルが統計的に優れていることが確認された。更新された質量と軌道周期に基づき、各惑星の分類が再検討され、特にKepler-396 cが揮発分豊富なスーパーパフ惑星であることが確認された。さらに動的シミュレーションと共鳴角の解析により、3惑星が安定した三体アプシダル共鳴チェーンを形成していることが判明した。
papers.relevance_reason: 軌道力学・共鳴構造の解析だが、MLやサロゲートモデルは不使用

papers.title: When Will You Hand It Over? A Hidden Start Delay Makes Self-Play Handover Robust to Unfamiliar Partners
papers.summary: Cooperative self-play can teach a humanoid to receive an object without any human data, but the partner it meets after training is never the one it trained with; we show that a fluent self-play handover policy breaks with unfamiliar partners, identify the main cause, and repair it. In a physics-based parcel handover between a Unitree G1 and a learned giver, both trained by alternating PPO self-play, the receiver completes 95% and 90% of handovers with its own partner (two training seeds) but only 31% with scripted partners it has never met. Paired interventions isolate the cause: under a shared reward the learned giver always starts its offer at once, so the receiver learns a single rendezvous, and delaying its own partner by one second cuts success from 95% to 6% (87% to 34% in the second seed). We introduce hidden start-delay randomisation (HSD), a one-line rule on the learned partner that the receiver never observes. After 300 further updates, success with unseen scripted partners rises from 31% to 80% in both seeds, against 35--41% for a budget-matched control. The gain holds on a fresh scenario seed, on eleven held-out partner conditions and on partners that start later than any training delay; it cuts high-force contact three- to five-fold and needs no retraining of the partner.
papers.title_ja: いつ引き継ぐか？隠された開始遅延が自己対戦による引き継ぎを未知のパートナーに対して頑健にする
papers.summary_ja: ヒューマノイドの物体受け渡しにおいて、自己対戦（Self-Play）で学習したポリシーが未知のパートナーと対峙すると成功率が大幅に低下する問題を指摘する。原因は、学習パートナーが常に即座に動作を開始するため、受信側が単一のタイミングに過剰適合してしまうことである。本研究では、学習パートナーに受信側が認識できない「隠された開始遅延」をランダムに付与する手法（HSD）を提案する。この手法により、未知のスクリプトパートナーとの成功率が31%から80%へ向上し、接触力の低減も実現した。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習の手法だが、LLMや軌道力学との直接的な関連は薄い

papers.title: Complex Schr\"odinger Bridges
papers.summary: Diffusion bridges have emerged as versatile frameworks for facilitating transformations between arbitrary data distributions. However, these approaches are hindered by an immense optimization space and its underlying high-order structures. This paper explores a variant of diffusion bridges for solving real-world problems in complex vector spaces governed by scaling and rotation laws, such as Hamiltonian structures. To address this, we introduce conformal optimal transport (COT), a complex-valued transportation framework designed for physical systems with geometric and dissipative dynamics under a geometric lifting. Building on this, we propose a new class of dynamical diffusion bridges, called complex Schr\"odinger bridges (CSBs), whose derived algorithms can handle diffusion-based tasks using a conformal geometric prior. For scalability, we propose image-to-image CSB (I$^2$CSB), a tractable diffusion-bridge technique with an analytic spiral posterior. Finally, we implement a physics-informed CSB algorithm within simulations of quantum electrodynamics, mimicking the logical behavior of quantum logic gates. Our extensive results validate the underlying theory while highlighting advantages of complex-valued diffusion.
papers.title_ja: 複素シュレーディンガーブリッジ
papers.summary_ja: 拡散モデルの最適化空間の複雑さを解決するため、幾何学的・散逸的ダイナミクスを持つ物理系向けに「共形最適輸送（COT）」を提案する。これに基づき、複素値の拡散ブリッジである「複素シュレーディンガーブリッジ（CSB）」を定義し、解析的な後確率を持つ画像間変換手法 I²CSB を開発した。さらに、量子電磁力学のシミュレーション内で物理情報付き CSB アルゴリズムを実装し、量子ロジックゲートの挙動を模倣することに成功した。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報付き拡散モデルだが、軌道力学やLLM効率化とは直接無関係

papers.title: Binarization as an Attack Surface in Weightless Neural Networks
papers.summary: Weightless Neural Networks (WNNs) are lightweight classifiers that binarize their inputs and learn by storing binary patterns in lookup memories, which makes them attractive for resource-constrained tasks such as intrusion detection. Because a small perturbation that crosses no binarization threshold leaves the binary input unchanged, WNNs may appear naturally robust to adversarial examples; a perturbation that does cross a threshold, however, can still change the prediction. We study this tension in WiSARD, the canonical RAM-based WNN, and in two variants that replace its memories with Bloom filters, Bloom WiSARD and BTHOWeN. A continuous perturbation reaches these classifiers only by crossing an encoding threshold, changing at least one binary tuple, and redirecting a memory query; we formalize this mechanism with a threshold-crossing bound and a response-margin certificate for standard Boolean WiSARD. Controlled MNIST experiments compare linear and data-driven thermometer encodings under model-agnostic sensitivity probes, a score-based Simulated Annealing attack, and surrogate-transfer attacks. Changing only the encoding while keeping each model otherwise fixed shows that encoding granularity can trade a small clean-accuracy loss for a large decrease in attack success. On the Bot-IoT, CICIDS, and UNSW-NB15 intrusion-detection datasets, adversarial perturbations lead WNN detectors to classify many attacks as normal traffic and to raise false alarms, even when their aggregate accuracy remains high.
papers.title_ja: 重みなしニューラルネットワークにおけるバイナリ化のアタックサーフェスとしての役割
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、入力バイナリ化とルックアップメモリを用いた軽量分類器である重みなしニューラルネットワーク（WNN）の敵対的頑健性を分析する。閾値越えによるバイナリ状態変化が予測に与える影響を形式化し、MNISTおよび侵入検知データセットで攻撃成功率を評価した。エンコーディング粒度の調整により、精度のわずかな低下を代償に攻撃成功率を大幅に低減できることを示した。また、集計精度が高くても敵対的摂動により誤分類や偽陽性が生じる脆弱性を特定した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM効率化や軌道力学とは直接無関係だが、軽量モデルのセキュリティ評価というML手法全般に関わる。

papers.title: bihalofit-JAX: A Differentiable Code for the Nonlinear Matter Bispectrum and its Projected Statistics
papers.summary: Theoretical predictions for the nonlinear matter bispectrum and related projected statistics have been historically very expensive to evaluate, leading many analyses to rely on emulators to speed up slow numerical codes. We show in this paper that this need not be the case: improved numerical techniques can be leveraged to directly evaluate predictions for the nonlinear matter bispectrum and projected statistics at speeds preferable for inference. We present bihalofit-JAX, an open-source, fully differentiable code for the nonlinear matter bispectrum based on the BiHalofit fitting formula, which includes numerous related projected statistics such as angular bispectra, skew spectra and aperture statistics. It computes $10000$ triangles of the matter bispectrum in $\sim1$--$2\ \rm{ms}$ per cosmology, one to three orders of magnitude faster than other implementations. It agrees numerically with the original BiHalofit code to better than $0.02\%$ on average over the cosmologies the formula was calibrated on, where the formula itself is accurate to $\sim20\%$ against simulations. It is also efficiently vectorised such that one can compute e.g. $500$ cosmologies in $\sim 2\ \rm{ms}$. This speed-up grows even more in the case of the third-order aperture statistics, which we compute in $\sim 6\ \rm{ms}$ for one cosmology, between $3\times10^3$ and $2.4\times10^4$ times faster than other publicly available codes. The pipeline is fully differentiable, and we demonstrate its performance in a simple inference problem, comparing the No-U-Turn Sampler (NUTS) to gradient-free inference with the affine-invariant ensemble sampler (emcee).
papers.title_ja: bihalofit-JAX: 非線形物質ビスペクトラムとその射影統計のための微分可能コード
papers.summary_ja: 宇宙論における非線形物質ビスペクトラムの計算を高速化し、推論プロセスに直接適用可能な微分可能コード「bihalofit-JAX」を提案する。既存の実装比で1〜3桁高速に計算でき、500個の宇宙論パラメータセットを約2msで処理できる。また、NUTSサンプラーを用いた勾配ベースの推論と、勾配フリー手法との比較を通じて、微分可能性がもたらす推論効率の向上を実証している。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲート高速化と推論効率化の手法は関連するが、対象が宇宙論であり軌道力学ではないため

papers.title: Strongly Monotone Central Path Equations for Quadratic Cone Programs
papers.summary: We introduce a canonical central path for the homogeneous embedding of quadratic cone programs, defined by strongly monotone equations whose modulus is the barrier parameter. We prove that the path exists uniquely, is smooth, and lies on a sphere of fixed radius. Under mild regularity assumptions, its limit points recover optimal solutions or certificates of infeasibility. Exploiting the fact that the embedding operator has a closed-form resolvent, we derive Josephy-Newton steps that retain the nonlinear embedding equations and linearize only the complementarity conditions. Each step reduces to quasi-definite linear system solves and a scalar quadratic. Using this, we derive a new predictor-corrector interior-point method with a surrogate formulation that allows the predictor and corrector to share a single sparse factorization. We provide an open-source implementation, cpo3, for linear and quadratic programs. On 675 instances from eight benchmark collections, with presolve and crossover disabled, cpo3 achieves the highest verified solve count (631) and the lowest penalized shifted geometric mean runtime among the tested open-source and commercial solvers. It is the only tested solver to solve all 138 Maros-Meszaros instances to high accuracy. Moreover, we establish Euclidean and local-norm error bounds that motivate a warm-start heuristic for the proposed algorithm, yielding up to 2.3x median runtime speedup over cold starts on perturbed Netlib and Maros-Meszaros problems.
papers.title_ja: 二次錐計画のための強単調中心パス方程式
papers.summary_ja: 二次錐計画の同次埋め込みに対して、バリアパラメータを単調性係数とする強単調方程式で定義される正規中心パスを導入する。このパスの存在・一意性・滑らかさを証明し、閉形式の解像演算子を利用したJosephy-Newtonステップを導出する。予測子-補正子型内点法を提案し、予測と補正で疎行列分解を共有するサロゲート定式化により計算効率を向上させた。オープンソース実装cpo3は、主要ベンチマークで既存ソルバーを上回る検証済み解算数と最速の幾何平均実行時間を達成した。
papers.relevance_reason: 数値最適化アルゴリズムであり、ML手法や軌道力学とは直接無関係だが、最適化基盤技術として間接的に関連。

papers.title: Impact of Grid-Forming Inverter Placement and Penetration on Local and Aggregate Frequency
papers.summary: Modern power systems are undergoing a huge shift in generation mix, including inverter-based resources that are fundamentally changing the stability dynamics of the grid. Thus, synchronous Generators (SG) are gradually being displaced by Grid-forming inverters (GFM) that are proposed as a solution to continue supporting grid stability. However, the effect of GFM placement in the network on frequency performance and how well aggregate-frequency assessment captures placement sensitivity observed in local frequency metrics remains unclear. This paper evaluates all SG and droop-controlled GFM assignments in the IEEE 39-bus system. A reduced-order model is used for the exhaustive search with load disturbances applied separately at every eligible load bus while considering nadir and Rate of Change of Frequency (RoCoF) derived from both device rating weighted aggregate frequency and local bus frequencies. Results reveal that at fixed GFM penetration, placement produced up to 104 mHz variation in worst-case local nadir and 0.21 Hz/s in maximum local RoCoF. Aggregate-frequency assessment reduced the apparent across placements by 89\% for nadir and 88\% for RoCoF at 50\% GFM penetration. These results indicate that aggregate-frequency assessment alone may obscure favorable or adverse placement effects on local frequency performance.
papers.title_ja: グリッドフォーミングインバータの配置と導入率による局所および集計周波数への影響

papers.title: LightTAR: Light and Fast Target-Aware Representations for Multimodal Tabular Learning

LightTAR improves average predictive performance for all models and, averaged across models, improves prediction on almost every MulTaBench dataset. These gains come with a small increase in total runtime relative to PCA representations. papers.title: LLM-Guided Cluster Lifecycle Management: Deciding When and How to Evolve Behavioral Clusters
papers.summary: Behavioral clusters learned over user or item interactions drift as behavior evolves: some fragment into sub-behaviors, some converge, some disappear, and new patterns emerge. Two paradigms dominate the maintenance of evolving clusterings. Threshold triggers fire a pre-specified action when a hardcoded statistic crosses a cutoff; refit-and-track (MONIC-style) re-clusters every window and infers transitions from how the new clusters align with the previous window's. Both hardwire the decision into a threshold or a re-clustering rule. We study an alternative in which a large language model (LLM) makes the lifecycle decision in place. Given a threshold-free, whole-population view of the current cluster set (statistical health, labels, member texts, residual mass), the LLM decides per cluster whether and how to act (split, merge, retire, create, or no-action) without re-clustering. Because the useful signal channel depends on how informative the labels are, we fix a richness-conditioned policy in advance: statistics when label distinctiveness is low, fused statistics+semantics when it is high. On three public datasets spanning label richness (YooChoose 0.17, MOOC 0.50, News-Category 0.70), the policy-selected LLM mode obtains the highest F1 on all three, with far fewer interventions and stronger restraint than tuned threshold heuristics and a MONIC steelman (paired Wilcoxon p <= 0.003, bootstrap 95% CIs excluding zero). The gain is concentrated more in precision than recall. The useful modality shifts from statistics to semantics/fusion as richness rises. Semantics hurt on YooChoose, fusion is roughly neutral on MOOC, and the semantic channel is required on News. One base prompt template and one fixed policy serve all three datasets, whereas the tuned baseline collapses when moved between them. We treat this shift as a practitioner diagnostic observed on three datasets, not a validated law.

papers.title: A Multiscale Analysis of an Interplanetary Shock from IMAP, SOLAR-1, and the L1 Constellation to Earth
papers.summary: Collisionless shocks are primary sites of particle acceleration throughout the Universe. Transient, mesoscale structures forming around these shocks influence their energy conversion efficiency, yet remain poorly observed at interplanetary (IP) shocks: spacecraft sample the shock transition briefly, and single-point measurements cannot disentangle temporal evolution from spatial structure. Here, we examine a fast, CME-driven IP shock of 2026 January 19, observed by IMAP, SOLAR-1, Wind, ACE, DSCOVR, and Aditya-L1 at L1 and by ARTEMIS and MMS near Earth, to determine its spatial and temporal structure. At MHD scales, a pre-existing solar wind flux tube is overtaken by the shock as it crosses the L1 fleet. This inflates the apparent magnetic compression ratio far beyond the ideal strong-shock limit of 4, showing that upstream and downstream intervals can sample different plasma and bias single-spacecraft estimates. At kinetic scales, IMAP and SOLAR-1, separated by only $\sim$7 $R_E$ ($\sim$340 ion inertial lengths), sample the same foreshock yet record localized structures that differ measurably; these are the first candidate signatures of large-scale foreshock transients at an IP shock. Further upstream, shocklets appear hundreds of $R_E$ ahead of the shock, consistent with steepening of ambient solar wind waves. Near Earth, the shock-to-flux-tube arrival lag increases to approximately six minutes, corresponding to a nominal sheath extension of $\sim$50 $R_E$, indicating sheath expansion over $\sim$200 $R_E$ of propagation. Together, these results show that the IP shock, its foreshock, and its sheath evolve across multiple scales from L1 to Earth, underscoring the need for multipoint measurements to resolve the underlying processes.

papers.title: Euclid DR1 Legacy Science on Ultracool Dwarfs: New URLD candidates in Euclid and SPHEREx

papers.title: Activation Steering the Nan-Shan in Typhoon

papers.title: LuthorSQL: A One-Pass Text-to-SQL Model as System 1 for a Slower LLM Agent

papers.title: PaperCritic: Training AI Reviewers to Assess the Soundness of Papers

papers.title: Fuse-All MoE Inference Kernel with Load Balancing on TPUs
